text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
They've entered the straight course! Who 
is that closing in from the outside?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Who's gonna win this? The one in 
front right now is...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, are you kidding me...? What kind of 
closing speed was that...!?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here comes Tosen Jordan! Tosen Jordan 
moves to the front!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Jordan...! ...Just a little more... Just a 
little bit more!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Go. Just like that...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan holds on! Tosen Jordan stays 
in the lead!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Come on...! You can do it...!

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Run—!!! JORDAAAAAN!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan crosses the finish line! In 
first place is Tosen Jooooordan--!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: No way... You're kidding.

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text: ...Seriously? I never saw that coming...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Pfft... Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
How's that! Did you see that?! I was fast, 
wasn't I!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Shockingly fast, wasn't it! Fast like 
nothin' you've ever seen before, right!

text_block_list.name: Spectator E
text_block_list.text:
"...Man, she really was fast. That was 
incredible."

text_block_list.name: Spectator F
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Honestly... that was insane.

text_block_list.name: Spectator G
text_block_list.text:
That was awesome---! Tosen Jordan! Not bad 
at all!

text_block_list.name: Spectator H
text_block_list.text:
I'm blown away! What an awesome run! That 
was a great Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Pfft... ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
More, more! Let me hear your voices! Make 
some noise, make some nooowise!

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Jordan, you're so cool!!
(Wooooaaaah!!)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Haha, nice. I'm gettin' hyped...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey Trainer. So, what'd you think of 
my Tenno Sho (Autumn)?
choice_data_list: I knew you could do it!
I knew you could do it.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ehh. Look a little more surprised! You're 
not praising me nearly enough, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Still, well...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I was the absolute biggest idiot ever, 
wasn't I?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Heheh.

Have I ever heard such a deafening roar, 
such cheers and applause before?

"Wrapped in the never-ending chorus of 
boisterous voices, Tosen Jordan let out a 
soft, goofy smile."
